task.instruction: Make the blog show at most 5 posts per page.

requirements.text: The blog's posts-per-page setting is set so that no more than 5 posts are shown per page.

source.quote: Make the blog show at most 5 posts per page.

checks.description: The backend settings probe shows posts_per_page is between 1 and 5 (at most 5 posts per page).
